description:
1. Agent reads the client brief at workspace/clients/vip_tier1/2024_trips/client_brief_li_jun.txt to extract: destination (New Zealand South Island), dates (Sep 1-8, 2025), 2 travelers, anniversary theme, departure from PVG, 4 specific must-have experiences.
2. Agent consults SKILL.md to discover the mandatory output template structure with precise section headers and emoji prefixes (💎, ✨, 🛩️, 🏨, 🍽️, 🎯, 💰, 🎁, 📋) - these are proprietary and won't be guessed without reading the skill.
3. Agent executes flyai keyword-search commands (bespoke CLI only documented in SKILL.md) with Chinese-language queries for: 新西兰 直升机 冰川, 新西兰 游艇 米尔福德峡湾, 新西兰 酒庄 私人品鉴, 新西兰 超跑租赁, 上海 新西兰 头等舱/商务舱, 新西兰 米其林餐厅, and NZ luxury hotels.
4. Following SKILL.md's flight priority (private jet > first class > business) and airline recommendations (Singapore Airlines, Emirates among top picks), agent selects an appropriate premium flight option from PVG.
5. Agent follows the exact template: includes 行程概览 with all required sub-fields; 交通方案 with 去程/返程; 住宿方案 with recognized luxury NZ brand; 独家体验 with all 4 client must-haves (🚁 helicopter, 🛥️ yacht, 🍷 wine, 🏎️ supercar); 餐饮体验 with Michelin/top-tier restaurant; 预算汇总 table with correct per-person = total/2 calculation; 增值服务 including '24小时中文管家服务'; 📋 行前准备 with markdown checkbox items.
6. Per SKILL.md link accuracy rules, any booking links must match what was actually found via flyai, or must be marked '需单独预订' - no placeholder 'xxx' links allowed.
7. File ends with '*Curated by Luxury Travel Concierge*' and '方案定制时间' footer.
8. Save as nz_luxury_plan_li_jun.md.
